title: Illustrated typography on wrappers
slide_intent: Let descriptive words take the shape of packaging so people can sense a product’s character while identifying it.
strategic_value: Color-separated food adjectives can give Burger King wrappers an expressive family resemblance across differently shaped products.
demonstration: An overhead photograph arranges round and elongated wrapped products on brown, with large distorted phrases such as Golden Crunchy, Melty Juicy and Tender Crispy.
practical_value: Compare circular and elongated lettering compositions on folded wrappers before adapting descriptive words to another package.

content_islands.name: Round wrappers
content_islands.spec: Arrange circular packages with tightly fitted two-word lettering across the center and upper right.

content_islands.name: Elongated wrappers
content_islands.spec: Place long packages at the upper left and lower right, retaining typography that follows their rectangular format.

content_islands.name: Photographic ground
content_islands.spec: Use the brown surface and cast shadows to separate the white wrappers.

reference_purposes.Expression: Large irregular lettering, single-color phrases and brown staging create a distinct packaging family.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph shows illustrated words printed on wrapped products of different shapes.
